dedupe_keys.name: geodaten teilaufstellung der regionalplane fur die windenergie 2020

description: Geodaten Teilaufstellung der Regionalpläne für die Windenergie 2020 is a dataset listed in German national open data portal (GovData), an open data portal, published or maintained by Land Schleswig-Holstein. Diese Daten spiegeln das Ergebnis der Verfahren zur Teilaufstellung der Regionalpläne I bis III (Windenergie an Land) in Schleswig-Holstein 2020 gemäß GVOBL vom 30.12.2020 wider. Zur räumlichen Steuerung der Errichtung von Windkraftanlagen sind Vorranggebiete mit der Wirkung von Eignungsgebieten für die Windenergienutzung (Vorranggebiete Windenergie) festgelegt. Coverage: Land Schleswig-Holstein. The portal files it under the publisher Land Schleswig-Holstein. Its tags are landesplanung, raumordnung, regionalplan, repowering, schleswig-holstein. It offers 1 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/SHP. The portal shows 2026-09-10 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-de-portal.
